results.title: Hedda
results.overview: Hedda Gabler finds herself torn between the lingering ache of a past love and the quiet suffocation of her present life. Over the course of one charged night, long-repressed desires and hidden tensions erupt—pulling her and everyone around her into a spiral of manipulation, passion, and betrayal.

results.title: Sex in Drag
results.overview: An intimate, unfiltered portrait of Sherry Vine - a performer who’s spent her life straddling gender, sexuality, and the unforgiving streets of New York City. What begins as a bawdy tale of her first hookup in drag with a drug dealer evolves into a deeper meditation on what it means to be desired—not just as a spectacle, but as a person. In Sex in Drag, Sherry Vine reflects on her most formative sexcapades and how defying labels, navigating secrecy, and grappling with hetero norms have led her to a love life in the margins. With sharp wit and aching honesty, Sherry dismantles the binary thinking around sexuality and challenges the shame and rigidity that still cling to queer desire.

results.title: Unknown Number: The High School Catfish
results.original_title: Unknown Number: The High School Catfish
results.overview: Vulgar, taunting texts blow up the phones of a teen and her boyfriend. Who's sending them — and why? This twisty documentary reveals the shocking answer.

results.title: Chelsea Drive
results.overview: Chelsea Drive displays three decades of Black student style, fashion and dance at the University of Virginia.

results.title: Jingle Bell Heist
results.overview: Two down-on-their-luck hourly workers team up to rob a posh London department store on Christmas Eve. Will they steal each other's hearts along the way?

results.title: I Am a Plaything
results.overview: Hyo-min, who became a prostitute by choice, undergoes sex training to serve clients under the supervision of Kyeong-seop, the manager of the establishment. She services countless men and even learns advanced techniques directly from Kyeong-mi, who works with her. Meanwhile, Kyeong-seop gradually opens his heart as he discovers the reason behind Hyo-min's decision to enter prostitution.

results.title: Strange Harvest
results.overview: Detectives are thrust into a chilling hunt for a sadistic serial killer from the past whose return marks the beginning of a new wave of grotesque, otherworldly crimes tied to a cosmic force.

results.title: The Choral
results.overview: As World War I rages on, Dr Henry Guthrie takes over a British choral society that's lost most of its men to the army. The community soon discovers that the best response to the chaos of war is to make beautiful music together.

results.title: En juldröm
results.overview: Zhala wishes for a real Swedish Christmas, complete with a visit from Santa Claus. But as a newly arrived refugee, it is difficult for her single father, Ahmed, to make his daughter's Christmas dream come true.

results.title: Chasing the Wind
results.overview: A focused city worker and a laid-back surfer - both heirs to the same company - find they have plenty in common when they join forces in the boardroom.

results.title: The Plague
results.overview: A socially awkward tween endures the ruthless hierarchy at a water polo camp, his anxiety spiraling into psychological turmoil over the summer.

results.title: The Pilot
results.overview: A cryptic exploration of a sitcom apartment.

results.title: The Photographer
results.overview: Inna, a young post-mortem photographer, arrives at a remote orphanage in northern Spain to capture the final image of Alejandra, a girl found dead under mysterious circumstances. But as her lens lingers on the tragedy, Inna begins to sense a dark presence within the orphanage's walls-an evil that refuses to remain hidden and threatens to make her its next subject.

results.title: Ella McCay
results.overview: An idealistic young politician juggles familial issues and a challenging work life while preparing to take over the job of her mentor, the state’s longtime incumbent governor.

results.title: Tokyo Taxi
results.overview: One day, taxi driver Koji Usami is tasked with driving 85-year-old Sumire Takano from Shibamata, Tokyo to a senior care facility in Hayama, Kanagawa. Sumire asks Koji to make some detours. Gradually opening up to her, Sumire begins to tell the story of her grand past...

results.title: Zombie Land Saga: Yumeginga Paradise
results.original_title: 劇場版 ゾンビランドサガ ゆめぎんがパラダイス
results.overview: It’s an alien vs. zombie showdown! Zombie idol group Franchouchou is ready to rock the upcoming Saga Expo—until an alien spaceship appears and rains destruction. As if things couldn’t get any worse, the legendary Tae Yamada regains consciousness and announces her intention to go solo to stop the invasion. With Franchouchou scattered and Earth in peril, can the group reunite in time to save Saga?

results.title: On the Sea
results.overview: In a rural town in North Wales, mussel harvester Jack has been married to his wife Maggie for over half of his life. He is troubled by his son Tom, who has little interest in the family trade. When Jack crosses paths with Daniel, an itinerant deckhand, their attraction poses an impossible dilemma.

results.title: Popeye's Revenge
results.overview: The legend of Popeye haunts a group of counsellors as they intend to open a summer camp.

results.title: Kalakal
results.overview: A seductive female garbage collector who embraces the life of an escort lady. Desperate to live a comfortable life, she leaves the dumpsite and enters the club. But can she also dump both her brother and her lover who remind her of her past?

results.title: Behind the Smile
results.overview: Ten years after Vlada Divljan's death, the family opens boxes with his belongings. Among other things, they find recordings made with a small camera. Vlada's footage of family life, as well as making music in his room or with a band, along with homemade animated adventures on a deserted island, take us deep into the intimate world of our famous musician.
